title: ANPL: Towards Natural Programming with Interactive Decomposition

layout.note: Two full-width tinted bands, Programming above (blue) and Debugging below (peach), each headed by a coloured tab; both end in the same right-hand chain of ANPL Program, black ANPL Compiler and Python Program with a result grid, joined by an orange elbow arrow from the first band to the second.

lesson: Draw a human-in-the-loop try-and-repair workflow as two tinted bands that repeat the same chain, end each with a verdict mark, and give every kind of user edit its own colour reused on the element it changes.
